name: Editorial collage
description: Paper borders, halftone details and cutout compositions.
caption: A small moment, told slowly.

name: Crayon
description: Wax crayon on toothed paper. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a hot-air balloon
caption: The morning everything changed.

name: Cyanotype blueprint
description: Ruling pen and spring-bow compass in white ink on Prussian-blue cyanotype stock. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a watch movement's going train, plan and section A-A
caption: Made by hand. Felt by everyone.

name: Broken colour
description: Opaque oil dabs from a loaded flat hog brush on primed linen, unmixed colours side by side for the eye to mix. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a small harbour at sunrise
caption: One scene. One feeling.

name: Charcoal, erased and redrawn
description: Vine and compressed charcoal on heavy rag paper, stumped, lifted with a kneaded eraser, redrawn over its own residue. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: one oak through four seasons on one sheet
caption: Where the story begins.

name: Coloured pencil
description: Wax coloured pencils hatched in one diagonal on toothy cream cartridge paper, hues layered, darks cross-hatched. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a wind-up tin robot mending a music box while a crow steals a screw
caption: Every frame, crafted.

name: Hand embroidery
description: Stranded cotton floss stitched through natural plain-weave linen in a beech hoop. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a botanical wreath with a honeybee
caption: A small moment, told slowly.

name: Flat vector
description: Pen-tool paths in a vector app, flat fills that land when a path closes, long-shadow shapes with a transparency ramp, a raster grain brush over the shade sides. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a regatta of small sailboats on a bay under hills, the leader rounding the mark
caption: The morning everything changed.

name: Folk-tale storybook
description: Gouache and watercolour over an HB pencil drawing on cream cartridge. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a boy carrying a rooster through a village kitchen garden at the edge of a birch wood
caption: Made by hand. Felt by everyone.

name: Cut-paper collage
description: Zero drawn lines. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a fox at dusk
caption: One scene. One feeling.

name: Newsprint halftone
description: Web-offset newspaper print. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a steam train crossing a stone viaduct at golden hour
caption: Where the story begins.

name: Isometric cutaway
description: Flat vector planes on a true 2. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a two-floor bakery cutaway at night, lit by its oven, the baker turning with a fresh loaf
caption: Every frame, crafted.

name: Marker comic
description: Alcohol-marker cel fills with a hard shadow edge under one heavy contour that thickens away from the light. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a Sanke koi turning under lily pads
caption: A small moment, told slowly.

name: Risograph
description: Soy ink, one layer per drum multiplied through its own registration offset; every other colour an overprint, tone a halftone screen per ink angle, white is bare paper. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a lighthouse at sunset
caption: The morning everything changed.

name: Low-poly
description: Triangle meshes projected by hand through a pinhole camera, each facet flat-shaded by its normal against one low sun, painter-sorted far to near; no 3D engine. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: A mountain lake at dawn: pink-lit range, spruce shores, a red canoe, reflections
caption: Made by hand. Felt by everyone.

name: Single-line engraving
description: One unbroken engraved line whose width follows a procedural tone field. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a moon spiralled out of one line
caption: One scene. One feeling.

name: Mid-century gouache
description: Opaque matte designer's gouache on warm illustration board, a dry brush dragged over the flats, a loose brush-and-ink line printed off register. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a hillside village where a girl flies a kite
caption: Where the story begins.

name: Chalkboard
description: Side-of-the-chalk scumble on a slate board, lit limbs worked twice, every stroke broken by the board's tooth with dust either side, ghosts of old lessons. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: the phases of the moon
caption: Every frame, crafted.

name: Oil on canvas
description: Opaque oil paint with hog-bristle brushes on a toned linen canvas, lean block-in to fat impasto. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: two pears and a copper pot by a window
caption: A small moment, told slowly.

name: Toy-theatre paper collage
description: A cardboard toy theatre. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: A seaside town on a toy-theatre stage: sea rows, harbour houses, a newspaper boat, a sun on a stick
caption: The morning everything changed.

name: Pixel art
description: A 120x120 grid of cells, each one of 16 declared palette colours, laid one cell at a time and blown up by a whole number, no smoothing. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a cat mid-pounce after fireflies in a moonlit garden
caption: Made by hand. Felt by everyone.

name: Ballpoint sketch
description: One blue ballpoint on cream cartridge, near-constant weight; tone only from where the hatching sits, plus the blob where a firm stroke stops. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a pocket watch lying on a table
caption: One scene. One feeling.

name: Pencil & watercolour
description: Graphite and pan watercolour on cold-press. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a ranunculus in bloom
caption: Where the story begins.

name: Rubber hose
description: India ink at one pressure on a clear cel over a blue-pencil rough, flat grey paint on the back, photographed and printed on black-and-white film. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a coffee pot mid-dance-step on a kitchen counter, steam curling
caption: Every frame, crafted.

name: Archival scrapbook
description: Foxed rag-paper album page; torn cards, cellulose tape, a clothespin on twine; copperplate engravings hand-tinted; typewriter, ransom-note cut letters, red pen, rubber stamp. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: How a honeybee finds flowers: the forager, the rose, the waggle dance, the evidence
caption: A small moment, told slowly.

name: Scratchboard
description: White china clay under black India ink; every mark is ink scraped away with a knife or scratch nib. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a lynx, head and shoulders, in moonlight
caption: The morning everything changed.

name: Pen-and-ink stipple
description: One 0.25 mm technical pen dotted straight down onto hot-press bristol; tone is dot density only. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a nautilus shell sawn in half, chambers lit from the upper left, cast shadow in dots
caption: Made by hand. Felt by everyone.

name: Storybook pencil + watercolour
description: Storybook graphite and gentle pan watercolour, drawn for a recurring character. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: Bit, waving, in storybook pencil and watercolour
caption: One scene. One feeling.

name: Sumi-e ink painting
description: One loaded soft brush of sumi ink, five dilutions, on unsized absorbent xuan paper, with a cinnabar seal. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: bamboo in wind with a tree sparrow
caption: Where the story begins.

name: Toy brick
description: Moulded ABS toy bricks, rendered flat-plastic in orthographic view. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a brick-built harbour tugboat on a baseplate
caption: Every frame, crafted.

name: Ukiyo-e colour woodblock
description: Water-based pigment printed by baren from hand-carved cherry blocks onto damp kozo washi. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: two grey herons in rain on a wooden drum bridge
caption: A small moment, told slowly.

name: Ink & line-wash
description: Wet washes first that flood past the line and settle along each shape's bottom edge, backruns, then a flexible nib thick on the press and hair-thin on the lift. Drawn as a finished illustration in one medium.
hero: a wren
caption: The morning everything changed.
